description: Test data for AI memory consolidation workflow - reviews STM and promotes to LTM

memories.content: Started working on the Redis refactoring project with Jeffery. The main issue is a 1095-line god object that needs to be split up.
Successfully split the Redis god object into three focused services: RedisMemoryService, RedisIdentityService, and RedisContextService. Much cleaner architecture now!
Fixed all the unit tests after the refactoring. Had to update imports and mocking strategies, especially for gentle_refresh which uses all three services.
Discovered a delightful bug - a test that only fails on Mondays! The weekday() function returns 0 for Monday but the test expected 1-7.
